events.fact: Spotify developer apps are created in the Spotify Developer Dashboard at https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard.
Newly created apps begin in Development Mode, which requires a Spotify Premium account for the app owner, limits developers to 1 Client ID, and caps usage at up to 5 authorized/allowlisted users.

As of May 15, 2025, Extended Quota Mode (production access) is restricted to established business entities operating an active, launched service with a minimum of 250,000 monthly active users (MAUs), commercial viability, and availability in key Spotify markets. Applications are submitted via a Google Form link provided in the docs.

Once a partner application form is approved, developers can request a quota extension from the Developer Dashboard (Settings -> Quota extension Request tab), which triggers a review taking up to 6 weeks.
The Spotify authorize endpoint is live at https://accounts.spotify.com/authorize and redirects to the Spotify login page.
